PATCH_004_OPENING_RIM.name: Opening Rim / Boundary Surface
PATCH_004_OPENING_RIM.mesh_region: Component 0, front opening perimeter (front face, Y ≈ negative direction, Z ≈ 0.2-0.65)

boundary_definition.outer_boundary: OPENING_CURVE (hard topology boundary, vertically elongated oval/pear shape)
boundary_definition.side_boundaries: BLEND to adjacent body patches (PATCH_001, PATCH_002)

surface_characteristics.curvature: VARIABLE (depends on exact opening rim geometry; likely concave toward exterior)
surface_characteristics.continuity_target: G1 with PATCH_001 and PATCH_002 along blend boundaries
surface_characteristics.shape_description: Inner surface of opening rim; likely matches swept/pulled profile onto shell

parametrization.v_direction: DEPTH (inward from rim edge into opening)
parametrization.note: Local coordinate system derived from opening curve, NOT global Z

PATCH_004_OPENING_RIM.patch_topology: 4-SIDED_QUAD or more complex if opening profile has inflections
ambiguity_flags: OPENING_DEPTH: How deep/thick is the opening rim? Affects v-direction parametrization.
OPENING_PROFILE_SHAPE: Is rim a simple cylindrical pull or more complex curve? Affects construction_method.
OPENING_CONTINUITY: Should opening rim be G0 (sharp edge visible), G1 (tangent), or G2 (smooth curvature) with surrounding body?
PATCH_004_OPENING_RIM.notes: This patch may be best handled by Rhino MatchSrf or similar continuity-based surface fitting after PATCH_001, PATCH_002 are established.
